title: Running late
hint: Read who's writing and how much it matters. Agree together what to write, type it and send. Then compare with the example.

context: 📍 You're on the metro. It's stuck in a tunnel.

msgs.t: Hi! I'm here 😊 Got us a table by the window.

scenes.example: Hi! So sorry — my train's **stuck** in a tunnel 🙈 I'm **running about 15 minutes late**. Can't wait to see you!

reply.t: No worries! 😊 I'll get us some drinks.

scenes.model: Hi! So sorry — my train's s{{tuck}} in a tunnel 🙈 I'm r{{unning about 15 minutes late}}. Can't wait to see you!

context: 📍 You're in a taxi. There's been an accident on the motorway.

msgs.t: Good morning! Just a reminder: your interview is at 10 today.

scenes.example: I'm so sorry — there's been an accident and I'm **stuck in traffic**. I'll **be about 20 minutes late**. Would 10:20 still work?

reply.t: Thanks for letting us know. See you at 10:20.

context: 📍 You're still at work. Your boss wants “a quick chat”.
⏳ No idea how long the chat will take.

msgs.t: We're all here! Where are you?? 😄

scenes.example: Sorry, guys! Still at work — my boss wants “a quick chat” 🙄 **Start without me!** I'll text when I'm on my way.

reply.t: No worries! We'll save you a slice 🍕

context: 👤 **Mark, your boss — a big client meeting**
📍 You're in another call. It's **running over**.

msgs.t: Morning! Reminder: the client's arriving at 9.

scenes.example: Morning, Mark! **Just a heads-up** — my call is **running over**. I'll **be there in** 10. Could you **start without me**?

reply.t: Thanks for the heads-up! We'll start without you.

context: 📍 You're at the cinema. You've got the tickets.
🙂 This time **she**'s late. Make your reply warm — not just “OK.”

msgs.t: Soooo sorry!! My train's been delayed 😩 I'll be 20 min late!

scenes.example: **No worries!** The ads take ages anyway 😄 I'll wait at the entrance with the tickets.

items: **Just a heads-up** — / I'm really sorry — – предупреждаю
I'll **be 10 minutes late**. – опоздаю на 10 минут
I'm **running a bit late**. – немного опаздываю
I'm **stuck in traffic**. – стою в пробке
My meeting is **running over**. – встреча затягивается
**Start without me!** · I'll **be there in** 5! – начинайте без меня · буду через 5
**No worries!** · **No rush!** – ничего страшного · не спеши
**Thanks for letting me know!** – спасибо, что предупредил(а)
**Join when you can!** – подключайся, когда сможешь

speaking: When were you last late? Who was waiting, and how much did it matter?
What did you write? How would you write it now? Use **two** phrases from the box.
Which is worse: 10 minutes late with no message, or 30 minutes late with a heads-up? Give **two** reasons.
How late is OK with friends, at work, on a first date? Agree on **one** rule for each.
